Vs

full_judgment:
Hasan Foez Siddique J: This rule Nisi was issued calling upon the respondents to show cause as to why they shall not be directed to implement the judgment and decree 28-7-1978 passed in Title Suit No. 291 of 1976 by the learned Subordinate Judge, now Joint District Judge, 2nd Court, Sylhet which was affirmed by the High Court Division of the Court and as to why they shall not be directed to make necessary correction of the record of right in respect of SA dag No. 59 under SA Khatian No. 1 of Mouza Monchora Upazila Kulaura, JL No. 109 District Moulvibazar, covering an area of 29.50 acres by mutating the same in the name of the petitioners. 

 2. The petitioner's predecessor got a contested decree in respect of the land as mentioned above in Title Suit No. 291 of 1976 passed the Subordinate Judge, Sylhet. The Government preferred First Appeal No. 119 of 1981 in the High Court Division which was ultimately dismissed. The decree holder Shafair Khasia died. His heirs transferred the entire land to this petitioner by four separate Kabala deeds. These petitioners getting the land by purchase, filed application for mutation in the concerned land Office. The Deputy Commissioner Moulvibazar wrote a letter addressing the Secretary, Ministry of Land, for necessary order for record the names of the petitioners in the khatian. But no positive step has not yet been taken inasmuch as the respondents are bound by the decree. In such a situation, the petitioners moved this application in this Court and obtained the present rule. 

 4. Mr MA Mannan, the learned Advocate appearing for the petitioner, submits that since the petitioner's predecessor obtained a contested decree against the Government, Forest Department and others and the said decree has been upheld by the High Court Division and the heirs of the decree holder transferred the question land to the petitioners so they are entitled to get their names mutated in the Khatian. The Assistant Commissioner land is bound by the decree and to perform his statutory duty to mutate the names of the petitioners in the khatian but he did not take any steps to mutate the names of the petitioners so he may be directed to record the names of the petitioner in the khatian. 

 8. It appears from the Judgment and decree of the said that said Shafair Khasia obtained contested decree against the Government in respect of the question land (Annexure-C to the Writ Petition). It further appears that against the said judgment and decree passed in Title Suit No. 250 of 1976 the Government preferred First Appeal No. 119 of 1981 which was ultimately dismissed. From Annexure-D series it appears that the heirs the said Shafair Khasia had transferred the entire land of this petitioners by separate kabala deeds thereby title and possession of the questioned land have been vested to the present petitioners. Accordingly, the petitioners filed an application before the Assistant Commissioner land for getting their names mutated in the khatian, Annexure-E shows that the Deputy Commissioner Moulvibazar, considering the relevant papers and opinion of the local Government pleader, sent a proposal to Ministry of Land to approve the proposal of mutation of the names of the petitioners in the khatian by a letter communicated under Memo No. ভুঃ রাঃ/ক-১/বিবিধ/২/২০০১/৩৩৮ dated 27-3-2001 but the Secretary Ministry of Land did not respond. 

 9. Since the petitioners predecessors, got contested decree which has been upheld by the High Court Division and they transferred the entire land by different kabala deeds, they are entitled to get their names mutated in the khatian.
